build_pali_gemma_model: build a PaliGemmaForConditionalGeneration model by loading vision tower, text model, and multi-modal projector from weights
create_vision_embeds: create vision embeddings from pixel values using the vision tower and multi-modal projector
merge_text_vision_embeds: merge text input embeddings with vision embeddings by replacing image token positions with vision features
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the text model with KV cache to produce logits and speculative logits
review_pali_gemma_initialization: review the PaliGemmaForConditionalGeneration initialization to understand how vision and text configs are quantized and loaded
